sources.entry: Omni - Notorized Niri and Hyprland inspired tiling window manager with animations. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/BarutSRB/OmniWM) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: OmniWM is a free, open-source, Apple-notarized tiling window manager for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 26 or later, combining Niri-style scrolling columns and Hyprland-style Dwindle BSP layouts.
summary.what_it_does: OmniWM automatically tiles windows on macOS using either a Niri-style scrolling layout (columns or rows that scroll, with tabbed containers) or a Hyprland-style Dwindle binary space partition layout, selectable per workspace. It supports multiple monitors with a routing map that controls directional focus, window moves and mouse warp between displays. Users can drive it through default and customizable keyboard shortcuts, a command palette, an overview of window thumbnails, and an optional local IPC interface with the bundled omniwmctl CLI. Additional features described include a Quake-style dropdown terminal (Ghostty, Kitty or foot), scratchpads and sticky windows, a workspace bar, Menu Anywhere, clipboard history and status-bar icon concealment. The README also documents persistence limits, such as Dwindle layouts being rebuilt after restart without fullscreen state or selection.
use_cases: automatically tile windows on a Mac
switch between workspaces on a Mac
replace the default macOS window arrangement
how_to_run: Or download the OmniWM-v .zip from the latest GitHub release and move OmniWM.app to /Applications
In System Settings > Desktop & Dock > Mission Control, turn ON 'Displays have separate Spaces' and log out and back in if needed
Launch OmniWM and grant Accessibility and Input Monitoring permissions
Enable 'Enable IPC' from the menu bar to use omniwmctl
Nix users: nix profile install nixpkgs#omniwm
notable: Niri scrolling columns and Hyprland Dwindle BSP layouts, switchable per workspace
Developer ID signed and Apple-notarized releases; SIP can stay enabled
Local IPC plus bundled omniwmctl CLI for scripting (disabled by default)
Multi-monitor routing map separate from the macOS display arrangement, with Mouse Warp
Quake terminal powered by Ghostty's libghostty, with Kitty and foot alternatives
caveats: Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26 or later; 'Displays have separate Spaces' must be on or window management pauses
Needs Accessibility and Input Monitoring permissions; several features need optional Screen Recording, Full Disk Access or macOS 27+
Dwindle restore after restart is partial: fullscreen state and selected window are not restored, and scratchpad memberships do not persist across restarts
Canary builds may contain regressions; updates are manual
